note: Rive Kaštela (Tools/riva/riva_build.py): zone = where the photo-derived riva is built (game x0, z0, x1, z1); per zone optional: surface (ploce = limestone slabs, default; beton = concrete quay / approaches), maxDist (paving at most this far from the sea, m; default 35), heights (local = follow the source ground and the road models within 3 m, for shores whose street is a road model), exclude (polygons never paved: beach sand coast.json misses), force (line + w strips paved anyway, own surface: sljunak = gravel beach promenade), breakwaters (riva-extras: leave the moles / piers of riva-extras/breakwaters.json to Magistrala/Riva: oprema i brodice); basins = sheltered harbour water forced to water (moored boats are not land); works = harbour works missing from coast.json (line + width, game x/z); parking = car parks digitised on the DGU DOF LiDAR 2022/23 mosaic (t_TX_TZ.png, game x/z), rows = bay rows (a -> b along the kerb, bays to the side 'side' (+1 = left of a->b in the game x/z plane), 2.5 m wide, 5 m deep)

zones.note: Lušiško brce istočno od Vitturija: kej lučice, lukobran, trg/park; plaže istočno ostaju plaže
mandrač i obala uz cestu (Trg Brce, Polantana, Trg Didića); betonska obala s kamenom kapom

force.note: šljunčana šetnica uz plažu kod Kaštilca (bez prometa; OSM promenade, coast.json beach je pokriva)

zones.note: kopnena strana Kaštilca, Primorska, Kupališni prilaz, cesta uz marinu Giričić: betonski prilazi, istezališta i kej marine; šljunčana plaža (coast.json beach) ostaje plaža
